claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self-development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show titles such as The Compound Effect, This Is Marketing, Sell Like Crazy, The Psychology of Money, Zero One, The Millionaire Next Door and How Successful People Think (motivational/business/self-development); Women, Rise Up! fits relationship/empowerment.

risks.risk: Photos carry the watermark 'EDENBOOKSTORE POSTED ON JIJI', so they may be a bookstore's listing images rather than the seller's actual books; the lot may not exist or may differ.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the same books with a handwritten note showing the buyer's name and today's date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the goods may not be as shown or may not exist.

risks.risk: Condition of individual pages (tears, highlighting, water damage) is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the page edges and inside pages of each book.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged or worn (tears, highlighting, water damage present).

risks.risk: Publication year or edition of the books is unknown; they may be outdated.
risks.proof: Photo of the copyright or title page of each book.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older or unknown editions.

risks.risk: Some books may be missing pages or covers.
risks.proof: Flip-through video or photos showing every page present and covers attached.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete (missing pages or covers).

risks.risk: Smell of the books (mold, smoke) cannot be assessed from photos.
risks.proof: In-person inspection; no photo or clip can settle odor remotely.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly musty or smoky.

proof_requests: Photo of the books with a handwritten note bearing the buyer's name and today's date
Close-up photos of each book's pages and copyright/title page
Flip-through video showing all pages and covers are present
response.reason: The witness identifies a lot of second-hand books with visible titles matching motivational, business and self-development, so a worst-case price is possible; page condition, edition, completeness, odor, and whether the photos show the seller's actual books remain unproven.
